text: THE HOME PAGE'S SECTIONS COME BACK FROM THE CLASSIC SITE, which is where this design is fully drawn. The versions that stood at /website through 24 Sep 2026 were reduced retellings of them: scheme cards without their photographs and without "Know More", an updates panel without its pause, a pledge section without the counts the Department publishes, organisation chips without their totals, a statistics bar without its gradient. About Us, Our Offerings, Our Organisations, the Nasha Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan section, Recent Documents, the centre finder, Activity Corner, Social Media and Need Support are now the classic components, which the redesign page already reused for the logo marquee and the SAMAVESH banner. TWO THINGS STAY FROM THE REBUILD because they were improved rather than reduced — the hero carousel and the SAMAVESH banner — and every correction made that day is kept: the register de-duplications, the corrected month, the de-addiction centre count, the image dimensions, the carousel's control. Verified after the swap: no cut title, no repeated document, no duplicate centre, on any tab. THE PRIME MINISTER'S QUOTE IS NOW THE CARD Figma draws (51601:56401) rather than a full-bleed band: the page already carries several tinted bands, so a band of its own put the most quotable thing on the page in competition with them, and the portrait is a cut-out that had nothing behind it. Its link now carries a text fragment, so "Read the Full Address" lands on the quoted sentence in a release of several thousand words and highlights it — verified verbatim against the live release, and ignored harmlessly by browsers that do not implement it.
